name: Validate the idea & name the company
tagline: The pre-formation act: the idea pressure-tested with a landing-page smoke test, then name candidates scored on domains, handles, and marks — the domain bought, the logo and palette set, the trademark filed.

name: Company launch
tagline: Incorporate, get the EIN, put the founders and cap table on paper, open the bank account, turn on payroll and the books.

name: Set up the office stack
tagline: Email and docs on the company domain, the chat, wiki, doc storage, and tracker stood up, the aliases routed to real inboxes.

name: Raise a seed round
tagline: Data room standing, SAFEs signed, wires verified, cap table made true.

name: Ship v1
tagline: Repo up and agent-ready, cloud and CI/CD wired, AI review on every pull request, errors and analytics watched from the first deploy.

name: The MCP-native stack
tagline: The stack picked for agent surfaces: code hosting, chat, tracker, wiki, CRM, errors, and analytics — at nearly every judged step the top vendor ships an official MCP server, so the agents that run your company can actually reach it.

name: Launch the website
tagline: Domain checked and bought, site generated, DNS wired, analytics on.

name: Launch on Product Hunt
tagline: Analytics and email capture on before launch day, assets ready, submitted to PH and the directories, the spike caught.

name: Ship it right
tagline: The shipping discipline: spec to deploy, the release tagged and noted, the pager wired, and when something breaks, a blameless postmortem with the follow-ups filed.

name: Get the first 10 customers
tagline: CRM up, outbound out, calls qualified, the first invoices sent.

name: Get paid
tagline: Connect payments, stand up subscriptions, send the invoice, reconcile the payout.

name: Price and monetize
tagline: Recurring revenue made real: the subscription product created and tested, the pricing change modeled and rolled out without burning the base, the bad charge refunded behind an approval.

name: Run support & keep customers
tagline: Support stood up, the cancellation met with a save offer, the churned cohort won back, the happy ones turned into a referral channel.

name: First hire
tagline: Offer out and signed, IP assigned, accounts provisioned, the first payroll run.

name: Build the team
tagline: From one hire to a team: the ATS and hiring pipeline stood up, benefits enrolled, the handbook published, the review cycle running, the option grants approved and recorded.

name: Go global
tagline: The workforce beyond your borders, without new entities: the international contractor signed and paid, the 1099 added to payroll, the hire abroad employed through an EOR.

name: Month-end close
tagline: Vendors paid, the books reconciled and closed, the runway known, the board updated.

name: The agent-run back office
tagline: The monthly money loop with the highest agent ceiling of any recurring playbook here: payroll run, vendors paid, invoices out, books closed, runway read, board updated — roughly nine steps in ten agent-routed, most reachable today over judged MCP servers and CLIs.

name: Board & governance rhythm
tagline: The corporate record kept clean: the deck prepped from live numbers, the meeting minuted and signed, the annual budget approved by consent, the state annual report filed.

name: Tax season
tagline: 1099s out in January, Delaware franchise tax by March 1, the R&D credit claimed, the 1120 filed.

name: Set up compliance (SOC 2-lite)
tagline: Password manager, SSO, devices under management, privacy policy and DPA, then the SOC 2 Type I run.

name: Land the enterprise deal
tagline: Type II and the pen test in hand, status page live, NDA signed, the questionnaire cleared, the contract closed.

name: Launch a VC fund
tagline: The vehicle formed and filed, the LPs signed and closed, the money loop running.

name: Raise the follow-on round
tagline: Cap table audited, data room fresh, the priced round closed, SAFEs converted, the 409A refreshed.
